Inside Your Brain

8 Chemicals Running
Your Entire Love Life

You think you're choosing. These chemicals already decided.

⚡
Dopamine
The obsession chemical. Creates "I can't stop thinking about them."
Attraction & Craving
🤝
Oxytocin
Released by touch and eye contact. Builds trust and the bond.
Bonding & Safety
🦋
Norepinephrine
Butterflies. Racing heart. Triggered before you know their name.
Excitement & Nerves
🌊
Serotonin
Drops when obsessed. Returns only when love becomes stable.
Obsession vs Peace
🔥
Testosterone
Pure lust. Activated by visual cues — before you know them.
Desire & Lust
🔗
Vasopressin
The quiet commitment force behind choosing to stay long-term.
Loyalty & Commitment
😰
Cortisol
Constant conflict raises this. It dissolves love from the inside.
Stress & Damage
🧠
Prefrontal Cortex
The only part you can train. Controls impulse and real choice.
The Only Power You Have
